Sentence (English): We had this same dishwasher at our first house and never had an issue.
Comments (English): [ Super quiet, adjustable and fast cleaning cycles! ] || ---------------- || We had this same dishwasher at our first house and never had an issue. When we moved into a new construction home in 2022, the island contained the most basic of basic GE dishwashers. Could hear every plate and utensil being hit by the water no matter where you were on the first floor; it sounded like someone was breaking in, so we always ran it overnight to avoid the ridiculous noise volume.Move forward two years, my wife and I could not stand it any longer and ordered this Samsung dishwasher from Costco. Once ordered, it was easy to schedule a delivery and install on a day that worked for us. Communication was easy with the movers and installer; everyone was very professional. I do wish that it could all be done at the same time and not have two separate appointments, but the installer broke it down easy for us: Delivery guys move the units because they have to keep on a separate schedule, installers can take their time at each house to make sure everything is connected and working.The unit itself: FANTASTIC. Ran two heavy loads of dishes to see if we could hear anything from the island. It's so quiet I kept getting up to make sure it was actually running! The auto open is great to reduce mildew build and it's a great visual reminder that the dishes have been run. The adjustable racks for larger dishes make loading a breeze. The third rack on top allows for lighter washing for kitchen utensils, measuring cups, etc. We've noticed that just gently rinsing your plates, glasses and utensils before putting in the unit, the 60 minute cycle is all it takes for getting clean. If you leave egg grim on and put it in, you'll have to boost the wash cycle. We've had it for almost two months with nothing but amazing results. Highly recommend!

Sentence (English): After using my new DW for a month, I think I'm familiar enough with its operation to point out a few things about it I've discovered.
Comments (English): [ Absolutely quiet, but a few odd features ] || ---------------- || After using my new DW for a month, I think I'm familiar enough with its operation to point out a few things about it I've discovered. 1) I was irked to discover that the only way I can program the delayed timing of the DW to start is by using the app. This wasn't revealed in a very obvious way, as I discovered when: I looked it up in the manual; saw many people wondering the same thing on community forums; and also when I called customer service. In fact, the rep's first comment to me when I asked how to set a delayed start time, was, "Isn't there a delay button? " I replied, "No, that would be obvious -- and there isn't one." 2) I also wondered how to know when more rinse agent needs to be added because this too is not at all obvious. The support chat told me to open it up and look at the level. That's not possible. It also said a light should come on when it needs more, but since I haven't seen where that light would appear, I'm not sure if it has gone off and if I need more. I need to dig into this more deeply, but again, SHOULD it be this complicated? 3) The DW door closes shut very tightly, with almost what feels like a vacuum seal. There are times when after operating, I would like to leave the door open a crack, to let excess heat or steam escape. I can't do that either, unless I place an obstacle between the body and the door of the DW to prop it open. I wonder why it's designed this way. Sentence (English): I didn't know it was possible to hate an inanimate object so very much.
Comments (English): [ HATE IT! ] || ---------------- || I didn't know it was possible to hate an inanimate object so very much. This dishwasher seems to be cheaply made and corners were cut. The biggest problem is there are just not enough tongs to keep the dishes in place. Every time I pull out a rack things goes flying around. I compared it to my old GE dishwasher, there are significantly less tongs and rows of tongs in this one. The spacing is too much and there just not enough, especially on the bottom. Due to this I think the capacity is less. If you have any small plates, there is virtually no where safe to put them. On the top, we end up leaving the glasses out on the counter and putting them in just before running it so they don't crash against each other every time you pull out the rack. This is annoying and clutters the counter with dirty glasses.2nd biggest problem is that the racks don't roll in and out smoothly. This leads to more crashing around. And angers everyone in the family on a daily basis. If there was a way to return this I would. But unfortunately, theses issues are by design and the thing "works".It's like they cut back on the basics, like usable dish racks, to add bells and whistles that are very optional, like bottle jets and a 3rd clunky rack.I even looked into replacing the racks, but that doesn't seem possible. So this thing will annoy us daily until my husband tears it out and throws it over the balcony or we save up for another new one. I'm so disappointed as this was an "investment" for us. We were better off with the 18 yr old dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I didn't know it was possible to hate an inanimate object so very much.
Comments (English): [ HATE IT! ] || ---------------- || I didn't know it was possible to hate an inanimate object so very much. This dishwasher seems to have been made as cheaply as possible. The biggest problem is that there are just not enough tongs to keep the dishes in place. Every time I pull out a rack everything goes flying around. I compared it to my old GE dishwasher, there are significantly less tongs and rows of tongs in this one. The spacing is too much and there just not enough, especially on the bottom. Due to this I think the capacity is less. If you have any small plates, there is virtually no where safe to put them. On the top, we end up leaving the glasses out on the counter and putting them in just before running it so they don't crash against each other every time you pull out the rack. This is annoying and clutters the counter with dirty glasses.2nd biggest problem is that the racks don't roll in out smoothly. This leads to more crashing around. And angers everyone in the family on a daily basis. If there was a way to return this I would. But unfortunately, theses issues are by design and the thing "works".I even looked into replacing the racks, but that doesn't seem possible. So this thing will annoy us daily until my husband tears it out and throws it over the balcony or we save up for another new one.

Sentence (English): I absolutely LOVE my Maytag dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ ACTUALLY DRIES THE DISHES!  ] || ---------------- || I absolutely LOVE my Maytag dishwasher. A dishwasher that actually dries the dishes! I like the deep racks to hold the dishes. I like that the inside tub is stainless steel, not plastic. It's very simple to operate. I like that it has choices to cover all soil levels on dishes from a quick wash to a power wash, but not so many options (bells & whistles) that it will just break more quickly/often. This is the second Maytag dishwasher I have had over the years. I find them to be the best. I would have given this dishwasher a 5 rating, except for the fact the cup closure, where the dishwashing tablet is held, feels very flimsy, like it may break with repeated use. In addition, the spinning sprayers feel a little flimsy, but they do the job. My dishes have been coming out beautifully clean and dry! Also, it is just slightly louder than my previous dishwasher, but the fact that it actually dries the dishes makes up for that. I love it! It looks great! I am hoping for some longevity here. Thank you, Maytag! I would recommend this dishwasher to a friend. In fact, I am so pleased with the dishwasher, the next appliance I need to replace, if Maytag makes them, I will be giving them serious consideration.

Sentence (English): This Bosch is really quiet.
Comments (English): [ Even better than expected ] || ---------------- || This Bosch is really quiet. I expected that, but not THIS quiet. Our kitchen is open to the living room. We can watch TV with normal volume and not even notice the dishwasher is on. Very impressive. Even if it is quiet it still needs to perform, and perform it does. We have always prewashed our dishes, probably as a throwback to the older models that didn't clean that well. I convinced my wife to put some dishes in that were dirty. They came out great. Not really believing the results she left a soup bowl sit on the counter for 2 days with caked on split pea soup. It came out clean as well. Now we knock off the big stuff and just put them in. We've had really good results with Finish pods but also with generic store brand gel. I was worried about drying, but with the exception of plastic tumblers everything has come out fine. The remote app was easy to set up, and while its kinda cool to play with it really isn't needed. I've never had the need or desire to start the dishwasher remotely, but I may put some soap in it and try it just because I can. I do appreciate the app warning me when it is low on rinse aid. Couple of minor gripes. The " clean" light does not stay on very long. Our previous 20 year old model had a light that stayed on until the door was opened. The app notifies you when the cycle is done, but why can't the light just stay on? The second gripe is the silverware basket is so tiny. Barely holds 2 or 3 place settings. We wound up removing it and use the extra space for big things. The third rack has plenty of room for forks and spoons so its not a problem. Overall I'd say it is worth the extra money over a regular old standard dishwasher. Totally happy with this purchase.

Not really believing the results she left a soup bowl sit on the counter for 2 days with caked on split pea soup. It came out clean as well. Now we knock off the big stuff and just put them in. We've had really good results with Finish pods but also with generic store brand gel. I was worried about drying, but with the exception of plastic tumblers everything has come out fine. The remote app was easy to set up, and while its kinda cool to play with it really isn't needed. I've never had the need or desire to start the dishwasher remotely, but I may put some soap in it and try it just because I can. I do appreciate the app warning me when it is low on rinse aid. Couple of minor gripes. The " clean" light does not stay on very long. Our previous 20 year old model had a light that stayed on until the door was opened. The app notifies you when the cycle is done, but why can't the light just stay on? The second gripe is the silverware basket is so tiny. Barely holds 2 or 3 place settings. We wound up removing it and use the extra space for big things. The third rack has plenty of room for forks and spoons so its not a problem. Overall I'd say it is worth the extra money over a regular old standard dishwasher. Totally happy with this purchase.

Sentence (English): First - the dishwasher does do a good job cleaning, no question.
Comments (English): [ Wire racks let dishes fall through, but does clean ] || ---------------- || First - the dishwasher does do a good job cleaning, no question. HOWEVER - the racks themselves are terrible! Bottom rack wheels come off constantly, the wiring on the racks is too far apart to the point dishes actually fall through the cracks (where sides/bottom of top rack meet, enough for a 1-c measuring cup to fall through - not to mention plastic containers/lids! ). Also, the top rack has no level-ish sections, so no matter how you place cups or glasses, they constantly fall over or tilt sideways onto other dishes. The bottom rack has too many "big plate" sections that I had to squeeze together to make smaller to hold other items. I've never seen dishwasher racks designed so oddly.Smaller issues (and probably nit-picky, I get it) from a design standpoint that I didn't really think about until it was installed - I prefer a cleaner look. You can either have the dishwasher flush with the cabinets and the footer is back about 3" from the toe kick, or it is flush with the toe-kick and sticks out 3" from the cabinetry. Also, the front panel of the dishwasher doesn't fold over where the controls are, so there is a large black line visible between my white dishwasher/ white countertop that doesn't look great. Also, I had to paint the medallion on the bottom because every time my eye caught it I thought it was a mouse! It feels like this was designed cheaply and by someone who has never done dishes. I just bought about 6 months ago but it is so aggravating to use I will probably replace.

Sentence (English): Dishwasher rated "A" with almost all the possible options (wifi, zeolite drying, efficient dry, cutlery drawer and flexible basket) however the whole thing does not seem very solid compared to our previous Siemens from 10 years ago.
Comments (English): [ Good but nothing more ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher rated "A" with almost all the possible options (wifi, zeolite drying, efficient dry, cutlery drawer and flexible basket) however the whole thing does not seem very solid compared to our previous Siemens from 10 years ago. I expected at least the same quality but it is clear that cost control (or profitability) does not allow for noble materials: - the front door is made of "plastic", very/too light... - the filaments of the basket and drawer seem fragile However on the functions, the wifi allows you to configure the device well and the whole thing is good. No luck, impossible to operate the efficient dry (automatic door opening) and there is still moisture on the cutlery and cups... (I hope for after-sales service on this point). In short, does the job but I have doubts about the durability because the general impression makes you think you bought an entry-level product.

Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY FROM HOME DEPOT ] || ---------------- || *DECENT DISH WASHER BUT DO NOT ORDER FROM HOME DEPOT* The dish washer itself is pretty good, I think I would give it 3.5/5 - it's pretty loud and doesn't have a good heated dry, but overall it gets the dishes pretty clean. The reason my review is only 2 stars is my overall experience with Home Depot and the delivery teams. I placed a large appliance order (nearly $6k) and after the experience I had with TERRIBLE delivery service, installation, and customer support I will NEVER order from Home Depot again. I understand that the Home Depot contracts their delivery service from a third party, but they should still be held accountable. We never received any communication regarding a delivery window for the appliances (for any of the multiple deliveries), we always had to reach out to try and have Home Depot get this information from the delivery team for us. The first delivery team we had decided it wasn't worth their time to deliver, blocked my number so I couldn't help with directions, and caused over a week delay in actually getting the appliances. The Home Depot requires you “prep” for delivery by emptying appliances, removing them from the wall, and unplugging them. That means we spent a week without the use of anything, microwave included, as it was a wall mounted unit that could not be used on the counter. The customer service team at Home Depot that tried to reschedule the delivery did not understand the warehouse/delivery team scheduling, and set us up for a delivery that never happened. After multiple follow up phone calls with multiple different answers/solution attempts, all 6 appliances showed up on a day that they were NOT scheduled to arrive. The delivery team was nice, although not knowledgeable. I had selected the option to swap the direction the dryer door opened, and this delivery team did not understand how to do that, so they ended up breaking the door and causing another 10 day delay to get a new dryer. They also did not have me sign for the delivery, give me any delivery paperwork, or contact information for issues with the appliances. I saw later on the delivery confirmation email, that they forged my signature on those documents. The team that delivered the replacement dryer informed me that it was not possible to swap the direction of the dryer door — it absolutely is, I was able to get it done in about 30 min. Overall the second team was better, getting me to sign paperwork and giving me contact info in case of any issues with the dryer, but still disappointed in not receiving a service I paid for. The Home Depot team told me to call back after the delivery was complete to get compensated for the delivery Issues, noting typically 10-20% of the order total. They didn't even give me 5%. Beyond disappointed with Home Depot. I also asked for links to individually review the delivery teams, which they told me I would receive via email. I shouldn't be surprised but I never received any email or communication for this. I would recommended the dish washer, but DO NOT BUY FROM THE HOME DEPOT.

Sentence (English): I haven't been able to install it for about 3 weeks after purchasing it.
Comments (English): [ This is the worst. Never buy it. ] || ---------------- || I haven't been able to install it for about 3 weeks after purchasing it. When you purchase it, you will get a call from an LG installer and they will introduce you to an LG partner company. That partner company is a company that does construction before the dishwasher is installed, but they don't do the construction properly, and every time the LG technician visits, they only tell you that the dimensions don't match, that there is a problem with the gas valve, and other problems, and they tell you (me) to contact the partner company again and ask them to do this and that. Then I will tell the partner company again, and the partner company will make another schedule and come back, and neither the LG technician nor the partner company communicate, and the consumer has to make a schedule in the middle and do everything. They say that it's not their fault, but they put off the work, and every time they visit, the technician changes, problems keep happening, money is wasted, and time is wasted. I asked people around me that LG technicians are the problem, but they tell me to never call an LG partner company. If I had known sooner, I would never have purchased LG. If you had no choice but to purchase it, please do not call LG's partner companies and find a separate company that installs and repairs the dishwasher. It seems that partner companies travel all over the country, so please avoid them. If you are purchasing, I cannot recommend LG at all. I do not think it is a problem even if you tell them the problem through customer service. I want to tear it all up when I think about the time I wasted for 3 weeks, staying at home, not being able to go to work, and wasting money. I hope there are no more victims. Please find another company. I am serious.
Comments (Original): [ 최악입니다. 절대 구매하지마세요. ] || ---------------- || 구매후 3주가까이 설치를 못했습니다. 구매하면 LG설치기사에게 전화가 오고 LG협력업체를 소개시켜줍니다. 그협력업체는 식기세척기가 들어가기전 공사를 해주는 업체인데 공사도 제대로 하지않고 LG기사는 방문할때마다 치수가 안맞고 가스벨브도 문제고 이것 저것 문제만 알려주고 협력업체랑 다시 연락해서 이렇게 저렇게 해달라고 하라고 소비자에게(본인) 전달합니다. 그럼 저는 다시 협력업체에게 전달하고 그럼 협력업체는 또 스케줄 잡아서 다시 온다하고 LG기사도 그렇고 협력업체도 둘다 소통을 하지않고 소비다가 중간에서 스케줄 잡고 다 해야합니다. 서로 잘못은 없다고하고 일은 미루고 방문할때마다 기사는 달라지고 문제는 계속 생기고 돈은 돈대로 날리고 시간은 시간대로 버리고 주변사람들에게 들어보니 LG는 기사님들도 문제지만 LG협력업체는 절대 부르지말라고 하네요 더 일찍 알았으면 절대 LG구매안했습니다. 혹시 어쩔수없이 구매하신 분들은 LG협력업체 절대 부르지마시고 따로 식세기설치및공사 해주는 업체 따로 알아보세요 협력업체는 전국 다 다니는거 같으니까 거르시길 바랍니다 구매전이시라면 전 LG추천 못드리겠습니다. 고객상담으로 문제를 말해도 문제라고 생각 하지 못하고있습니다. 3주동안 시간버리고 집에있고 일못가고 돈버린거 생각하면 다 찢어버리고 싶네요 추가 피해자분들은 없으면 좋겠습니다. 다른거 찾아보세요. 진심입니다

Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher who improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. My house is a newlywed home, but since we are a renter couple, we were denied the dishwasher installation. So I have been living sadly as a person who was in charge of washing dishes myself. Then, with a really good opportunity! I got to try the Media Countertop Dishwasher. If it is not possible to install it in the built-in installation, why didn't I think of installing it on the countertop? I will use it for 2 days after installation and write an honest review! **Oh, and you definitely need a hole (a line to draw water from the faucet under the sink)! If you don't have one, you have to drill a hole. I didn't know, so I almost drilled a hole! Please refer to this. ----------------------- Summary 1. A good product with a reasonable price and reasonable capacity. 2. The automatic door opening function is really essential! It's so good. 3. It does the dishes for me, so I have more time. My quality of life has improved. 4. When installing it, the drain pipe comes out, which is a shame in terms of appearance. 5. The cleaning function is average, and it is good at removing grease! -------------------------------------------------------------- <Advantages> 1. Low price It seems like you can use the dishwasher at a low price compared to other models. There are many countertops with similar capacity that cost around 500,000 won. However, I think the advantage of this product is that you can use a product made with good technology at a low price. 2. Appropriate 6-person dishwasher I heard that the capacity is really important for a dishwasher! But we are a newlywed couple without a baby and we are renters, so we couldn't bring in a dishwasher with a large capacity. After actually using a 6-person dishwasher, it seems like it can handle from a household of 1-2 people to a family of 4 for one meal! In fact, I recommend that a family of 4 use a dishwasher with a larger capacity ^^ 3. Advantages of the countertop Dishwashers can be divided into built-in and counter-top types! In fact, I would rather have a built-in type even if I die soon. So I just lived without it because I thought I wouldn't use it if the built-in type wasn't installed. As I lived here, I got stressed out from washing dishes, so I decided to use a countertop, but there were advantages! First of all, it was easy to move and install, and since it was right next to the sink, it was very convenient because I could put it in the dishwasher tray right after the first wash. 4. Automatic door opening function I think those who didn't have this function would have been really uncomfortable. I didn't know because I was using it for the first time, but when I looked it up, I found that after washing, you have to open the door to dry it, but since the door opens automatically, it's convenient, and since the wet steam is released right away, it dries more fluffily. I definitely recommend this function! <Disadvantages> 1. Perforation during installation This is something I was really worried about. Since we are tenants, I was really uncomfortable about drilling holes in the kitchen countertop. What I want to say is that first of all, the reason for installing the countertop is probably because there is no built-in space, or there are people who are renters like me, so ask the installer as much as possible! I think I would have been sad if I had just accepted it and drilled a hole and extended the line! I wrote it long in hopes that it would be of some help. Haha. ^^:;; 2. Regret in terms of appearance After all, when I was installing it, I was a little disappointed because the drain pipe was visible in terms of appearance! I thought about this part in advance. -------------------------------------------------------------------- Although it was a Coupang experience group, I was really interested in it and it was a product I needed, so I think it was lucky that I used it this time! The product is not lacking or insufficient compared to other expensive products, and I think it is a really good product! Lastly, you need a separate dishwasher detergent! I think it is important to find a good product for this. I hope everyone installs it well and buys a good detergent to really improve their quality of life!

I definitely recommend this function! <Disadvantages> 1. Perforation during installation This is something I was really worried about. Since we are tenants, I was really uncomfortable about drilling holes in the kitchen countertop. Fortunately, there was a 2cm hole with a rubber stopper in my house, so I asked him to put it in there, and he said it would be possible, but he said I had to extend the cord? So. Hmm. What I want to say is that first of all, the reason for installing the countertop is probably because there is no built-in space, or there are people who are renters like me, so ask the installer as much as possible! I think I would have been sad if I had just accepted it and drilled a hole and extended the line! I wrote it long in hopes that it would be of some help. Haha. ^^:;; 2. Regret in terms of appearance After all, when I was installing it, I was a little disappointed because the drain pipe was visible in terms of appearance! I thought about this part in advance. -------------------------------------------------------------------- Although it was a Coupang experience group, I was really interested in it and it was a product I needed, so I think it was lucky that I used it this time! The product is not lacking or insufficient compared to other expensive products, and I think it is a really good product! Lastly, you need a separate dishwasher detergent! I think I will use quick and automatic mainly. When there are few dishes, quick is enough, and in the evening, automatic is enough. It seems that the water comes out 95% dry. I’m even happier now that the price has gone up by 50,000 won.
Comments (Original): [ 세척도 잘되고 꽤 많이 들어가요! ] || ---------------- || 생각보다 후기가 엄청 많지않아서 후기 하나하나 정독한 후에 샀어요. 6인용이지만 꽤 큽니다. 상세사이즈 미리 확인이 필요합니다. 깊이 수치가 없어서 비슷한 다른 제품들 비교해서 뚜껑열었을 때 82센치로 체크했고 그 정도 확보해두었습니다. 저희집은 정수기를 작은 걸로 교체하고 자리가 남아서 가능했어요. 그리고 기사님이 좋은 위치 잘 잡아주세요.  6인용이지만 4인가구 한끼 식사는 모두 들어갈 수 있어요. 컵7개 냉면기 4개 국그릇밥그릇5개 반찬통1개 소스그릇1개 수저 주걱 여러개 .  저기에서 좀 더 들어갈 수 있어요. 쓴지 2일차라 ㅋㅋ 아직 테트리스 연습중이에요.  오늘은 카레 먹었는데 냉면기 세척수준 아주 좋습니다. 물론 애벌은 했어요. 건더기랑 묻은 것은 흐르는 따뜻한 물에 슬슬 흔들어서 씻어내고 넣었어요. 참고로 p7 자동모드로 돌렸습니다.  자동문열림 없어서 조금 고민했는데 애초에 밥먹고 식세기 돌리고 바로 밖으로 나가거나 뭐 그럴일이 없어서 괜찮은 것 같아요. 가족들 라이프 스타일 상 식세기 돌리고 외출해서 집에 사람이 1명도 없는 경우는 잘 없을것 같아요. Sentence (English): <<This is a review of a product I bought with my own money after much deliberation.
Comments (English): [ It's bigger than I thought. ] || ---------------- || <<This is a review of a product I bought with my own money after much deliberation.>> We were a family of five, but now our children are in college and have moved out, so we're now a family of three. As our family has grown smaller, we've decided to clean up the dishes on the sink. We happened to see a dishwasher from Shinsegae and decided to buy it. Since we have a small family, a built-in dishwasher has a large capacity, so after much deliberation, we chose this product. It was installed the very next day after ordering. The delivery and installation were quick, which was great. However, it would have been nice to be notified in advance that an additional installation fee (20,000 won) would apply depending on the faucet. The installer told us that it was winter, so we couldn't use it right away after installation and recommended using it in the evening or the next day. The installer was very friendly. The noise level isn't as loud as I thought. I'm not particularly sensitive to noise, so it's not a big deal. However, it's larger than I thought. Think of it as the size of two Cuckoo 10-serving pressure rice cookers with the lids open. I hope this helps anyone considering installation. As the installer said, if possible, I'd recommend using it in the evening or the next day. They say that putting in a little bit of detergent will help the dishwasher last longer. You can open the bottom and wash it, but I was a little worried because the detergent compartment is just a recess, but after using it once or twice, I put a small amount in the bottom. You can use powder, solid, and liquid detergent in the dishwasher, but since this is my first time and I was worried about where to put the detergent, I ordered liquid detergent and am using it. I will post a review after using it a few more times.
Comments (Original): [ 생각보다 크기가커요. ] || ---------------- || <<많은 고민 끝내고 구입한  내돈내산 제품 리뷰입니다.>>...5인 가족이였다가 아이들이 대학생이라 독립하게되어 3인가족이되어 식구가 줄어서 싱크대 위 그릇들을 정리하기로 맘 먹으면서 우연한 기회 사용해보게된 식기세척기 신세계를 보고는 벼르고 벼르다 선택했어요.식구가 적기에 매립형 식기세척기는 대용량이기에많은 고민후에, 이 제품을 선택하게 되었어요.주문 후 바로 다음날 바로 설치 완료.배송과 설치가 빠르게 이루어져 무엇보다 좋았어요.다만 설치시 수전에 따라서 설치비(2만원)가 추가된다는걸 미리 사전에 공지해 주시면 좋을듯합니다.기사님께서 겨울이라 설치해도 바로 사용 불가능하다고저녁이나 다음날 사용을 권장한다고 말씀해  주시더라구요.설치기사님 완전 친절하신거있죠.소음, 생각보다 크지 않아요.전 아주 예민한편 아니여서인지 그다지 신경쓰일 정도는 아닌듯해요.다만~ 크기가 생각보다 큰편이라 생각됩니다.쿠쿠압력밥솥10인용 뚱껑 열어둔거 2개 붙여둔 크기라 생각하면설치 고민이신분들께 도움되지 싶어요.기사님께서 그러시는데,가능하면 애벌정도는 하셔서 넣는게 식기세척기 오래 사용한다고그러시더라구요. 바닥부분 돌려 열어서 세척하면 되기도 하지만요.세제 넣는 부분이 그냥 옴푹 파인거라서좀 신경 쓰였는데 1~2번 사용후엔 바닥에 소량 넣고있어요.식기세척기 용 가루,고체,액체 모두 사용 가능하고는 하지만전 처음이기도하고 세제 넣는 부분이 신경 쓰여서 액체 세제 주문해서 사용중입니다.실사용기는 몇번 더  사용해보고 올릴께요.

Sentence (English): I was using a 12-person dishwasher, but when we moved, there wasn't enough space for a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that makes you sigh once a day. ] || ---------------- || I was using a 12-person dishwasher, but when we moved, there wasn't enough space for a dishwasher. After washing dishes by hand for a few days, it just didn't work out, so I bought this one. Hmm. First-time dishwashers will probably be satisfied, but those who already have large, powerful dishwashers will probably be disappointed, so I recommend considering this. I was prepared for the capacity, but it's much smaller than I expected. If you put in a small pot for a child's soup, the first rack can only hold a few plates and a cup. And there's only room for a few spoons and chopsticks. Still, even if you're washing dishes by hand and running it three or four times a day, it's fine because I was prepared. However, I don't know if the washing blades are too weak or the program isn't good enough, but if the water doesn't reach even a little bit, it doesn't clean properly. My 12-person dishwasher was able to clean every area where the water could reach, even when stacked on top of each other, but this one is. If you look at the attached picture of the stainless steel containers, you can see that I placed two of them side by side at a 45 degree angle, and one was washed and the other was washed exactly that way. Silicone cookware usually comes out like this one out of two times. Sentence (English): I used to use a 12-place setting dishwasher, but after moving, I didn't have space for it.
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that makes you sigh once a day. ] || ---------------- || I used to use a 12-place setting dishwasher, but after moving, I didn't have space for it. I tried hand-washing for a few days, but I couldn't stand it anymore, so I bought this product. Hmm. I think first-time dishwashers will be satisfied, but if you've been using a large, high-performance one, you'll likely get frustrated, so I'd advise you to think it over carefully. First off, although I was prepared for the capacity, it's much, much smaller than I expected. If you put in just one small saucepan for warming up soup for the kids, the first rack is practically empty with just a few plates and one cup. Also, you can barely fit many cutlery racks. As for knives, there's only enough space for a paring knife. Still, since I was prepared for that and run it three or four times a day while doing hand washing, it was fine. However, whether the washing blades are too weak or the program isn't very good, if the water stream doesn't reach even the slightest spot, it very honestly doesn't clean it. With the 12-place setting dishwasher, even if items were stacked, everything the water stream could reach was cleaned. If you look at the attached photo of the stainless steel containers, I placed two side by side at about a 45-degree angle; one was washed, but the other came out exactly like that. Silicone cookware usually comes out like this about one out of every two times as well. Also, I always pre-rinse them before putting them in, but sometimes missed food scraps or chopped green onion pieces dry and stick to the dishes, turning into dried vegetable flakes. It is a dishwasher suitable for households that eat light meals and use just a few rice bowls, plates, and cups!

Sentence (English): <<This is a review of a product I bought with my own money after much deliberation.
Comments (English): [ It's bigger than I thought. ] || ---------------- || <<This is a review of a product I bought with my own money after much deliberation.>> We used to be a family of five, but as my children moved out to become college students, we became a family of three. Since our household size had shrunk, I decided to organize the dishes on the sink. I happened to try a dishwasher by chance and saw a whole new world, so after much consideration, I finally chose this one. Because our family is small, built-in dishwashers require a large capacity. After much thought, I selected this product. Installation was completed the very next day after ordering. The quick delivery and installation were the best part. However, it would be helpful if you could notify us in advance that an additional installation fee (20,000 won) applies depending on the faucet. The technician told me that since it is winter, it cannot be used immediately after installation and recommended using it in the evening or the next day. The technician was incredibly kind. As for the noise, it isn't as loud as I expected. Perhaps because I am not particularly sensitive, it doesn't seem to bother me much. However, I think the size is larger than I anticipated. If you think of it as the size of two Cuckoo 10-person pressure rice cookers with their lids open placed side by side... I think this will be helpful for those considering installation. The technician told me that if possible, pre-washing the dishes before putting them in helps the dishwasher last longer. He mentioned that, although you can open the bottom section to clean it. I was a bit concerned because the detergent dispenser is just a deep indentation, but after using it once or twice, I just put a small amount in the bottom. While it is compatible with powder, solid, and liquid dishwasher detergents, since this is my first time and I was concerned about the dispenser area, I ordered and am currently using liquid detergent. I will post a review after using it a few more times.
Comments (Original): [ 생각보다 크기가커요. ] || ---------------- || <<많은 고민 끝내고 구입한  내돈내산 제품 리뷰입니다.>>...5인 가족이였다가 아이들이 대학생이라 독립하게되어 3인가족이되어 식구가 줄어서 싱크대 위 그릇들을 정리하기로 맘 먹으면서 우연한 기회 사용해보게된 식기세척기 신세계를 보고는 벼르고 벼르다 선택했어요.식구가 적기에 매립형 식기세척기는 대용량이기에많은 고민후에, 이 제품을 선택하게 되었어요.주문 후 바로 다음날 바로 설치 완료.배송과 설치가 빠르게 이루어져 무엇보다 좋았어요.다만 설치시 수전에 따라서 설치비(2만원)가 추가된다는걸 미리 사전에 공지해 주시면 좋을듯합니다.기사님께서 겨울이라 설치해도 바로 사용 불가능하다고저녁이나 다음날 사용을 권장한다고 말씀해  주시더라구요.설치기사님 완전 친절하신거있죠.소음, 생각보다 크지 않아요.전 아주 예민한편 아니여서인지 그다지 신경쓰일 정도는 아닌듯해요.다만~ 크기가 생각보다 큰편이라 생각됩니다.쿠쿠압력밥솥10인용 뚱껑 열어둔거 2개 붙여둔 크기라 생각하면설치 고민이신분들께 도움되지 싶어요.기사님께서 그러시는데,가능하면 애벌정도는 하셔서 넣는게 식기세척기 오래 사용한다고그러시더라구요. 바닥부분 돌려 열어서 세척하면 되기도 하지만요.세제 넣는 부분이 그냥 옴푹 파인거라서좀 신경 쓰였는데 1~2번 사용후엔 바닥에 소량 넣고있어요.식기세척기 용 가루,고체,액체 모두 사용 가능하고는 하지만전 처음이기도하고 세제 넣는 부분이 신경 쓰여서 액체 세제 주문해서 사용중입니다.실사용기는 몇번 더  사용해보고 올릴께요.

Sentence (English): I needed to replace a great Kenmore Elite dishwasher that was about 9 years old because the control panel went out and is no longer being manufactured by Whirlpool.
Comments (English): [ So-So Dishwasher - Terrible Detergent Receptacle ] || ---------------- || I needed to replace a great Kenmore Elite dishwasher that was about 9 years old because the control panel went out and is no longer being manufactured by Whirlpool. I tried buying another Kenmore, but with Sears out of business only Lowe's online has them. I bought one from there, and not only did the dishwasher leave everything wet on every cycle and had a very weird rack design, but it was also poorly installed and Lowe's wouldn't take it back 9 days after purchase. SO, out with Lowe's and in with Best Buy, where a very knowledgeable salesperson helped me buy this KitchenAid. I wanted something very quiet with a normal top rack that will hold glasses all the way across. This dishwasher was very quiet for the first 2-3 weeks, but is now a bit noisy. It cleans okay, and doesn't leave dishes wet.I am knocking off two stars, however, because this dishwasher's place for adding detergent is terrible. Sadly, all the other dishwashers on the market seem to have moved to a dinky sliding box for dishwasher detergent that is supposed to click into space. There is no longer a second section for additives like Lemi-Shine, and the main section is very difficult to get closed properly. (Yes, there's still a separate receptacle for jet-dry.) It seems to be designed only to hold those nasty little plastic packets that add micro-plastics to our water supply (Yuck! ), so if you use powder or liquid dishwasher detergent you cannot go one grain over whatever amount this little slider box was designed to hold. If you don't get it right, the slider will not close and you're reduced to getting powder all over your fingers as you try to remove just enough to allow the stupid slider to stay closed. AWFUL design change that I'm sure irritates the vast majority of users.

Sadly, all the other dishwashers on the market seem to have moved to a dinky sliding box for dishwasher detergent that is supposed to click into space.  There is no longer a second section for additives like Lemi-Shine, and the main section is very difficult to get closed properly.  (Yes, there's still a separate receptacle for jet-dry.)  It seems to be designed only to hold those nasty little plastic packets that add micro-plastics to our water supply (Yuck!), so if you use powder or liquid dishwasher detergent you cannot go one grain over whatever amount this little slider box was designed to hold.  If you don't get it right, the slider will not close and you're reduced to getting powder all over your fingers as you try to remove just enough to allow the stupid slider to stay closed.  AWFUL design change that I'm sure irritates the vast majority of users.

Sentence (English): We needed a dishwasher on a very short notice.

One complain I have was with the installation. The old dishwasher was hardwired. Needed a plug behind the dishwasher, per code. The installer offered to install one for $200. The wire was there. So he leaves, with us now having a defunct dishwasher in the middle of the kitchen. The oven installers show up and they are exactly what you'd what expect from Costco. They then looked at the dishwasher and said sure, we can install that no problem and after getting permission, got it installed and running in about 20 minutes. So clearly it seems Costco has a vetting issue for their installers. My advice is check out your pipes beforehand, if you have argumentative installers, ask them to leave and insist Costco sends a better company or order a return. I'm not sure if theyre running a scam but they clearly came here with no intention of completing the job. Also, the second time, they only sent one installer so I'm unsure how he was going to carry my old dishwasher down a flight of stairs and into his truck and then proceed to carry my new dishwasher from the garage, up a flight of stairs to install it. Sadly, rather than being excited about new appliances the whole experience left us feeling extremely frustrated.

Even if I forget to set the start time, I can still run a cycle whenever I remember even when I am not home. Three things I dislike are: 1) I can't seem to fit as many bowls/plates/cups on the racks as my old Samsung mid-range dishwasher. Sometimes, plastic utensils do not clean well. There had been a few times I noticed grease on dishwasher safe plastic utensils. Overall, I like the unit and will accustom to it, but there are areas that Bosch could improve on and wished I knew before I bought the unit.

(거슬리는 큰소음 아닙니다.)  뭐하나 빠지는게 없다. 배송, 디자인, 성능, 가격~!!!!♡완전 강력 추천한다. 바쁜 현대인.. 직장맘에게 꼭!필요한 식기세척기~ 삼성전자 비스코프 키친핏 빌트인 식기세척기!! 찐으로~~~강추 합니다. 정말~~~~!!너무 마음에 들어요. 후기가 도움이 되셨다면 '도움이 돼요' 부탁 드려요. 읽으시는 모든 분들 건강하시고 오늘도 행복한 하루 되세요.감사합니다.  ☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆

Every time we saw the pile of dishes, my husband and I would sigh more and more. After much deliberation, I decided to purchase a dishwasher. I thought that a 6-place setting would be sufficient for a family of three. Features: - As you can see in the video, it consists of a standard mode, sterilization, and powerful drying. The operation is not difficult at all; even a primary school student could do it. - And best of all is whether the door opens automatically after the cycle is finished. If I run it overnight, the door opens automatically, so the dishes dry well, and I just have to tidy up when I wake up in the morning. - I looked into models with hot air drying, but there was a price difference of about 100,000 won. However, I figured water pooling in places like baby straw cup lids wouldn't be completely dried even with hot air drying, and since the door opens automatically to dry, I didn't think it was really necessary! Cleaning Power. - This seems to be the most important factor. First, after purchasing the dishwasher, I used Ja*pong's dedicated solid detergent (which also rinses; apparently, stains form on dishes if you don't rinse). Every time we saw the pile of dishes, my husband and I would sigh more and more. After much deliberation, I decided to purchase a dishwasher. Our apartment isn't brand new, nor is it a very old building, but there was no space to install a built-in dishwasher, so I looked into this product. I thought that a 6-place setting would be sufficient for a family of three. Features: - As you can see in the video, it consists of a standard mode, sterilization, and powerful drying. The operation is not difficult at all; even a primary school student could do it. - And best of all is whether the door opens automatically after the cycle is finished. If I run it overnight, the door opens automatically, so the dishes dry well, and I just have to tidy up when I wake up in the morning. - I looked into models with hot air drying, but there was a price difference of about 100,000 won. Cleaning Power. - This seems to be the most important factor. First, after purchasing the dishwasher, I used Ja*pong's dedicated solid detergent (which also rinses; apparently, stains form on dishes if you don't rinse). I thought that a 6-place setting would be sufficient for a family of three. Features: - As you can see in the video, it consists of a standard mode, sterilization, and powerful drying. The operation is not difficult at all; even a primary school student could do it. - And best of all is whether the door opens automatically after the cycle is finished. If I run it overnight, the door opens automatically, so the dishes dry well, and I just have to tidy up when I wake up in the morning. - I looked into models with hot air drying, but there was a price difference of about 100,000 won. However, I figured water pooling in places like baby straw cup lids wouldn't be completely dried even with hot air drying, and since the door opens automatically to dry, I didn't think it was really necessary! Cleaning Power. - This seems to be the most important factor. First, after purchasing the dishwasher, I used Ja*pong's dedicated solid detergent (which also rinses; apparently, stains form on dishes if you don't rinse). Sentence (English): I used to be busy preparing baby food and doing the dishes, but now I can just run the dishwasher and relax!
Comments (English): [ Escape from Dishwashing Hell! ] || ---------------- || I am a working mom and stay-at-home mom raising a 16-month-old baby. Ever since my baby started eating solid foods after turning one, I would sigh just looking at the pile of dishes in the sink after finishing work. But washing dishes isn't the end of it; after washing them, I have to prepare the baby's meal for the next day, and then there are more dishes to wash. Every time we saw the pile of dishes, my husband and I would sigh more and more. After much deliberation, I decided to purchase a dishwasher. Our apartment isn't brand new, nor is it a very old building, but there was no space to install a built-in dishwasher, so I looked into this product. I thought that a 6-place setting would be sufficient for a family of three. Features: - As you can see in the video, it consists of a standard mode, sterilization, and powerful drying. The operation is not difficult at all; even a primary school student could do it. - And best of all is whether the door opens automatically after the cycle is finished. If I run it overnight, the door opens automatically, so the dishes dry well, and I just have to tidy up when I wake up in the morning. - I looked into models with hot air drying, but there was a price difference of about 100,000 won. However, I figured water pooling in places like baby straw cup lids wouldn't be completely dried even with hot air drying, and since the door opens automatically to dry, I didn't think it was really necessary! Cleaning Power. - This seems to be the most important factor. First, after purchasing the dishwasher, I used Ja*pong's dedicated solid detergent (which also rinses; apparently, stains form on dishes if you don't rinse). It was so convenient because I just needed to put one piece in the 6-place setting dishwasher without having to cut it. Also, I was very satisfied because the dishes were spotless and completely free of grease after the cycle. Operating Time. - It takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes when the dishwasher is fully loaded. It can run for a shorter time when there is less dishwashing. If I do it by hand, it finishes in under 30 minutes, but I guess the longer operating time is unavoidable in exchange for the physical convenience. Installation. - Please be sure to measure the width, length, and height before purchasing. I was told that installation costs apply if the kitchen countertop is marble, and that it should be installed about 30cm away from electric appliances like induction cooktops. My quality of life has definitely changed since using the dishwasher. I used to be busy preparing baby food and doing the dishes, but now I can just run the dishwasher and relax! It seems like a must-have item for moms raising young children! If my review was helpful, please press the "Helpful" button. Thank you.

Sentence (English): I am very impressed with my new dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Impressed ] || ---------------- || I am very impressed with my new dishwasher. It cleans dishes better than my previous dishwasher (Whirlpool). Dishes are shiny and spotless every time! I chose this model specifically for the Crystal Dry and it works! Of course you have to load properly so you don't have standing water in bowls, bottom of mugs etc, but it works! Dishes (even plastic) are dry! It is very quiet, I can hardly tell it's on and I have a small kitchen. The app works fine. It's not a super user friendly interface, but I haven't had any issues with connecting. I love that it sends a push notification to tell you it's done! Sentence (English): We got this to replace a 12-year old Whirlpool dishwasher, that never gave us any issues.
Comments (English): [ Nice Upgrade ] || ---------------- || We got this to replace a 12-year old Whirlpool dishwasher, that never gave us any issues. With this model, the addition of the third rack solved issues when needing to wash small glasses and cooking utensils. The top rack is perfect for those items. The downside to the third rack, is the middle rack is a bit on the low side when placing larger items in the bottom rack. Items like my microwave turntable plate or cookie sheets, no longer fit nicely along the edge of the bottom rack. The slides for the middle rack get in the way. I was able to get the turntable plate in with a bit of effort, only to run into an issue with the rotating water sprayer that is mounted to the bottom of the middle rack. This sprayer is a bit too long, as it spins it hit the turntable plate, if it were even a half inch shorter on each end, the problem would be solved. I also wish the silverware holder could be used on either side. It can only be used on the right side and my sink is to the left of the dishwasher, causing much unwanted leaning when loading. Finally, I also think the silverware holder was better off mounted to the door, as with my previous model. With it on the door, I could open it slightly and drop a single piece in. Now I have to open the door all the way and slide the bottom rack out in order to place one item in the silverware holder.

Sentence (English): On the positive side, our new Bosch dishwasher is very quiet, and very efficient.
Comments (English): [ Some great, some questions ] || ---------------- || On the positive side, our new Bosch dishwasher is very quiet, and very efficient. Nice engineering and design. However, I have experienced quite a few problems with getting my dishes acceptably clean! For example, my crystal glasses regularly come out with specs and dots and streaks. We have to rewash them, especially if we're having guests. We have looked to your videos to see if Bosch has suggestions about the placement of dishes in the racks that might improve cleaning performance. The videos have been general, and not helpful to us. Specifically, they do not answer the question of where is the best placement of my bowls and glasses to get them the cleanest. And I suspect that your engineering team designed these racks in a clever way, but it's not clear to me the best way to use them. For example, in the top rack, should my silverware have the handle pointed out or in? It's not clear in the videos or in the instructions.

The Bosch compared to the Kitchen Aid is significantly louder, and the Bosch doesn't have a "clean" light that comes on at the end of a wash. We do like the Bosch cutlery rack - it is much easier to unload and put the cutlery away than on the Kitchen Aid. The Bosch cleans just as well as the Kitchen Aid. If we were buying again, we'd probably go with the Kitchen Aid over the Bosch. The Bosch isn't bad, it just isn't great.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. If you purchase electronic products from Coupang, you will always feel secure because Coupang will take responsibility for everything from delivery to installation. You can purchase with confidence because it has a 2-year free warranty and Coupang directly handles after-sales service. There is also a dedicated customer center, so any inconveniences can be resolved immediately. They kindly answer questions about the product, and the installer is very kind and satisfied. Unlike other sites, you can specify a desired delivery date, and the fact that they even provide free support for ladder truck costs is a real advantage. The product size is slim because it is for 6 people, and although it has a 2-tier basket, the interior space is spacious, so you don't feel cramped at all. Since it is a window-type door type, you can immediately check the status of the dishwashing inside, and since the door opens automatically when it is finished, it opens automatically and releases hot steam even if you finish while doing other things, so it is very convenient. They say you have to use a special detergent. I think that's the only thing you need to be careful about. Before using it, I actually thought it would be faster and easier to do simple things by hand, but after actually using it, I really understand why everyone wanted to buy a dishwasher. Now, I think it would be too inconvenient if I didn't have a dishwasher. ^^ I only have 1-2 simple dishes, but when they're oily, it's often a hassle to wash the dishes, but if you put them in the dishwasher, they're cleaned cleanly, so it's very convenient.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  전자제품을 쿠팡에서 구매하면, 배송부터 설치 as까지 쿠팡에서 책임져주기때문에 항상 든든합니다. 2년 무상보증에 쿠팡직영에서 직접 AS를 진행해주기때문에 믿고 구매할 수 있습니다. 거기에 전담고객센터가 있어서 불편사항이 있더라도 바로바로 해결가능합니다. 제품관련 문의도 친절하게 답변해주시고 설치기사님도 아주 친절하시고 만족합니다. 다른사이트와 다르게 희망 배송일지정이 가능하다는 점, 사다리차 비용까지 다 무상지원하다는 점이 정말 장점입니다. 6인용이라 제품사이즈가 슬림하고, 2단 바스켓으로 되어 있지만 내부공간은 넉넉해서 좁다는 느낌은 전혀 못받고 있습니다. 창문형 도어타입이라 내부 설거지 상황을 바로바로 확인할 수 있고 끝나면 자동으로 문이 열리기 때문에 다른일하는 동안 끝나더라도 자동으로 열리면서 뜨거운 수증기가 배출되기 때문에 아주 편리합니다. 전용 세제를 사용해서 꼭 사용해야한다고 합니다. 그것 하나만 주의해주면 될 것 같습니다.  사용하기전에는 사실 간단한건 직접 손으로 하는게 더 빠르고 간단하지 않나 싶었는데, 막상 써보니까 왜 다들 식기세척기 사고 싶어했는지 너무 잘 느끼고 있습니다. 이제는 식기세척기 없으면 너무 불편할것같네요..^^  간단하게 그릇 1-2개있고 그런데 기름기가 있을때는  설거지하기 번거로운적이 많았는데 세척기에 넣으면 깨끗하게 닦이니 아주 편합니다.

Comments (English): [ I was looking for a dishwasher for ancestral rites or when I didn't want to do the dishes, and then I came across an ad on a website. It's easy to use, can be placed on top of the dishwasher without installation or construction, and is easy to move. The design is simple and well-reviewed. ] || ---------------- || I was looking for a dishwasher for ancestral rites or when I didn't want to do the dishes, and then I came across an ad on a website. It was easy to set up and use, easy to move, had a simple design, and good reviews. It caught my eye for several reasons, so I decided on it and looked at it several times. Then I made my decision. I couldn't use it the day I got home. I kept moving it around to find the most convenient location. It took me three days to get the hang of it and finally get it running. Oh no! It wasn't working. Is it a defect? I reviewed the installation instructions and checked the connections, and the water hose was incorrectly connected. I put in some small dishes and tried it. It worked. After finishing, I looked at the dishes. All the moisture was gone and there were no stains. Wow! This is great! I praised the dishwasher for its cleverness. On the third day of use, a stain appeared. Was it because the water flow wasn't right? Now I have to be careful to position the dishes properly and stand them upright. Since the dishwasher came as a freebie, I didn't need to buy anything else until I used it all up. However, since I use it every meal, I think I'll need to be careful every time I buy it. I'm satisfied with my purchase, as I'll be using it when I don't feel like doing the dishes or when guests have a lot of dishes.

Sentence (English): This is an update of my 1-star review for this item.
Comments (English): [ Should Be Zero Stars for Delivery and Installation ] || ---------------- || This is an update of my 1-star review for this item. I'd rate it zero, again for the installation only, because I haven't been able to use it more than once. I was led to believe that Home Depot had fired the subcontractor that it used to deliver and install major appliances in my area. I am assuming they didn't and used the same crew, beacuse they screwed it up and left me in even worse shape than before. The installer "tested" his installation by turning the dishwasher on for a few minutes -- with the warrantee cards and other manufacturer-supplied documentation still inside the machine. When I pointed this out, he stopped it and threw the printed materials away. After he left, I tried my first load. When it finished, I pulled the door open -- which caused the bottom tray to slide out, on top of the open door. The weight of this caused the entire dishwasher to tip over, because the installer failed to screw the top of it into the countertop (or whatever was supposed to hold it in place). Water went all over my floor (because it neve drained from the unit). When I cleaned it up, I saw that the installer had cracked one of my ceramic floor tiles and scratched the countertop.When I called Home Depot to complaint (demanding that they send someone to repair the mess their installer created) the rep claimed that he couldn't do that. I emailed a contact that I have in Home Depot's Executive Escalation Support and an assistant to its General Counsel (from the last time I had a major appliance delivered). I should have learned my lesson and not ordered from Home Depot again, because now that they took the old one away I no longer have a working dishwasher and am worse off than I was before.

Sentence (English): I bought this about a month ago after my 2 year old (different brand) dishwasher went out.
Comments (English): [ Great features ] || ---------------- || I bought this about a month ago after my 2 year old (different brand) dishwasher went out. I ask around to find out which brand was best and going to last, as I was not going to get the same brand that went out that quickly. Most of the people I talked to directed me to a Whirlpool, including the appliance mechanic. So far it has worked great! I am still figuring out the drying functions as my dishes are still not fully dry but I really love some of the features! The 3rd rack and adjustable second rack are awesome. It is so quiet, which is amazing as I have a small Kitchen/Living area. I really like that the inside of the dishwasher is stainless still instead of plastic. It seems like better quality. It is so big I end up running it before it is full most of the time. The sensor washing function is also really cool since you do not have to guess what cycle would be best to get your dishes clean. So far I am excited about this new dishwasher and high hopes it will last.

Sentence (English): I've had this Whirlpool dishwasher for about two months now, and although I'm usually hesitant to review a product in so short a time, I don't believe I'll run into any issues for many years.
Comments (English): [ Honest Review ] || ---------------- || I've had this Whirlpool dishwasher for about two months now, and although I'm usually hesitant to review a product in so short a time, I don't believe I'll run into any issues for many years. This unit replaced an older, other brand dishwasher when we moved into our new home at that time. Prior to the move I had a Whirlpool dishwasher that had similar features (- the top 3d rack) that was almost 15 years old that I installed myself and never had any issues with. That is why I stuck with Whirlpool. I cannot speak much of the installation of this unit because I had this one professionally installed. It took the installer about an hour to install so it must have been fairly easy and straight forward. When I installed the dishwasher I previously mentioned it was fairly easy. Ok, on to the review. Controls: there aren't that many, easy and comprehensive. I've tried all the cycles except 'sensor'' and 'quick' as I don't much use, or have a need for them. I do like the soak and clean cycle because I believe that does the best job. It takes about 8 hours for this cycle. The unit is quiet, so unless you have it in your bedroom you will not notice it running. I don't have many dishes to wash so I only wash dishes every few days. No residential dishwasher will wash pans with backed on food that's been sitting around for a few days so I give them a quick brush in the sink before I put them in the dishwasher. I use Cascade complete pods and Cascade rinse. I am not exaggerating when I say the glasses (particularly wine glasses) come out of the dishwasher clean AND spotless. Highly recommend.

So in their judgement we are expected to live with it, the finish and integrity of the exterior panels are not covered. Knowing now that KitchenAid panels can apparently rust within months, and this is considered a cosmetic characteristic of their products, we now know what to avoid. KitchenAid's lack of concern with product integrity, appearance, brand image, customer satisfaction, deserves the loss of our future business. But hey, they didn't have to replace the rusting door panel, better to leave it on display for all to see. Costco as well, do they really expect us to happily buy our future appliances there? We will hold on to our new, corroding dishwasher for now, it will be a conversation piece for our future gettogethers.

The installer also refused to install the dishwasher. He said, "I can't get the water valve to turn off." But I think it was because my drainage wasn't to code. I chose to install it myself the day before Thanksgiving (I installed the last one and it was good for 15 years.). The drainage goes to the garbage disposal. It has worked fine from November to January. Now, the last two weeks it is throwing a code FA E4 and it beeps and drains. The dishwasher won't work longer than 15 minutes. There is no water under the unit in the tray. The filter is clean, the sump is also clean with a little water which is normal, the garbage disposal is not clogged. The drain hose is not clogged. The spray holes are not clogged (I used pipe cleaners). The pump drains, because it is empty when I clear the code and drain it using cancel. Now I am sure I can't get any assistance because I chose to DIY install.

Sentence (English): Easy to install!
Comments (English): [ Love It!  ] || ---------------- || Easy to install! Super quiet! Some reviews complain about it not letting them know it's complete unless you have the app. That is not true. It does make a sound when the cycle is complete and has a light stating it. However the lights go off after awhile and if you don't hear it or not at home when the cycle is complete you may question that but if you open it you can tell that the dishes are clean. If you electricity to you unit is hot wired you have to buy the junction box($20) if you have a plug one will come with it. The junction box has to be mounted in a cabinet adjacent to your dishwasher. Make sure to run the cord as close to the wall as possible or you will not be able to push the dishwasher all the way back with out it hitting the cord. I highly recommend this unit and so far very pleased with it's performance.

Sentence (English): This is the second Bosch 300 we've owned - we bought one several years ago, but then moved to a new home.
Comments (English): This is the second Bosch 300 we've owned - we bought one several years ago, but then moved to a new home. It was a no-brainer to buy this model again for our new home. It runs very quietly, and does a great job cleaning everything placed on all three racks. Our first floor is open concept, and we have no problems running the dishwasher after dinner while we sit in the living room. We don't hear it running, no need to turn up the TV or wait until bedtime to run it.We have a ton of baby/toddler bottles and dishware, and it gets run daily for that. The plastics come out fairly dry, and our glass/dishes/silverware are fully dry after a run. The racks have plenty of flexibility for dishes large and small.

Sentence (English): The product is as good as expected.
Comments (English): [ ROUGH EXPERIENCE ] || ---------------- || The product is as good as expected. We purchased the dishwasher at the Lowes store in south Tucson including installation and take-away on Saturday Jan. 25. We were informed that the dishwasher would arrive Friday Jan 31, therefore we cleared our calendar for Friday. On Thursday Jan 30 we were advised the installation would be Monday Feb 3. So we cleared our calendar for Monday. On Sunday we were informed that installation would be Tuesday Feb 4. Therefore we had to clear our calendar for Tuesday. On Monday Feb 3 we got a text from CRST that our installation would be between noon and 3pm on Monday. We called CRST to confirm and they said they would check. Later we were informed that installation would be Tuesday between 1 and 4 pm. Installation took place on Tuesday Feb 4 at 3:30pm. This has been very frustrating and several important appointments had to be rescheduled which was unnecessary. We will advise our friends and neighbors that LOWES may not be the place to buy appliances!

(미닉스 공식페이지에서 정품등록 필수!)  전자제품에 관심이 많은 맥시멀리스트임에도 공간의 제약 때문에 특히 들이기 어려웠던게 식기세척기인데, 편리한 급수와 사용성을 갖춘 미닉스 덕에 저의 손은 조금 더 뽀송해졌습니다.  식기세척기를 고민 중인 1~3인 가구라면 망설임 없이 들여다 놓으세요. 후회 안합니다 :)

Comments (English): [ If you have a household of 1-3 people and have eczema, look no further than the Minix dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || -Review written after purchasing it myself- Summary of key points Size suitable for use by 1-2 person households (operates by putting in 5 cups, 3 sets of spoons, 2 noodle bowls, 3 plates, etc. No inconvenience in the usage pattern of a single-person household) The basket provides practical storage, but when placing a large cup of 470-500 ml, the 2-tier tray slightly floats off the hanger (no problem in use) It is very easy to refill the water tank (even if you open the water tank with the provided large water cup and pour it conveniently, it fills quickly without overflowing) Based on the strong water flow and high-temperature water, the cleaning power is not inferior to that of a large dishwasher that I have used before. If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work. Stuck-on stains may not wash off completely (I found that the scrambled eggs in the silicone spatula wouldn't come off). The water supply and drain pumps aren't very noisy, but if you use it in a confined space like a studio apartment, avoid using it late at night (depending on the building's soundproofing, it may disturb neighbors). The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem). The storage function makes it easy to store dishes hygienically at any time. The automatic door opening function only operates during the drying process, and it's a shame that it closes and doesn't stay open after the drying process is finished. The convenient water supply allows for convenient installation without having to place it on the kitchen floor. As a single-person household that drinks frequently, the dishwasher's configuration is simple: numerous cups, one or two rice bowls, two soup bowls, and two noodle bowls, two pots, two frying pans, and four sets of spoons. However, as a pattern of frequent dishwashing, purchasing a Minix dishwasher is a product that makes everyday life easier and more enjoyable. (Free from eczema!) The design is also appealing, and the 2-year after-sales service is also attractive. (Must register genuine product on the Minix official website!) Even though I'm a maximalist with a lot of interest in electronics, the dishwasher was especially difficult to bring in due to space constraints. Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and usability, my hands are a little softer now. If you're a household of 1-3 people considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate and get one. You won't regret it :)

Sentence (English): If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work.
Comments (English): [ If you have a household of 1-3 people and have eczema, look no further than the Minix dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || -Review written after purchasing it myself- Summary of key points Size suitable for use by 1-2 person households (operates by putting in 5 cups, 3 sets of spoons, 2 noodle bowls, 3 plates, etc. No inconvenience in the usage pattern of a single-person household) The basket provides practical storage, but when placing a large cup of 470-500 ml, the 2-tier tray slightly floats off the hanger (no problem in use) It is very easy to refill the water tank (even if you open the water tank with the provided large water cup and pour it conveniently, it fills quickly without overflowing) Based on the strong water flow and high-temperature water, the cleaning power is not inferior to that of a large dishwasher that I have used before. If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work. Stuck-on stains may not wash off completely (I found that the scrambled eggs in the silicone spatula wouldn't come off). The water supply and drain pumps aren't very noisy, but if you use it in a confined space like a studio apartment, avoid using it late at night (depending on the building's soundproofing, it may disturb neighbors). The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem). The storage function makes it easy to store dishes hygienically at any time. The automatic door opening function only operates during the drying process, and it's a shame that it closes and doesn't stay open after the drying process is finished. The convenient water supply allows for convenient installation without having to place it on the kitchen floor. As a single-person household that drinks frequently, the dishwasher's configuration is simple: numerous cups, one or two rice bowls, two soup bowls, and two noodle bowls, two pots, two frying pans, and four sets of spoons. However, as a pattern of frequent dishwashing, purchasing a Minix dishwasher is a product that makes everyday life easier and more enjoyable. (Free from eczema!) The design is also appealing, and the 2-year after-sales service is also attractive. (Must register genuine product on the Minix official website!) Even though I'm a maximalist with a lot of interest in electronics, the dishwasher was especially difficult to bring in due to space constraints. Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and usability, my hands are a little softer now. If you're a household of 1-3 people considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate and get one. You won't regret it :)

Sentence (English): The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem).
Comments (English): [ If you have a household of 1-3 people and have eczema, look no further than the Minix dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || -Review written after purchasing it myself- Summary of key points Size suitable for use by 1-2 person households (operates by putting in 5 cups, 3 sets of spoons, 2 noodle bowls, 3 plates, etc. No inconvenience in the usage pattern of a single-person household) The basket provides practical storage, but when placing a large cup of 470-500 ml, the 2-tier tray slightly floats off the hanger (no problem in use) It is very easy to refill the water tank (even if you open the water tank with the provided large water cup and pour it conveniently, it fills quickly without overflowing) Based on the strong water flow and high-temperature water, the cleaning power is not inferior to that of a large dishwasher that I have used before. If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work. Stuck-on stains may not wash off completely (I found that the scrambled eggs in the silicone spatula wouldn't come off). The water supply and drain pumps aren't very noisy, but if you use it in a confined space like a studio apartment, avoid using it late at night (depending on the building's soundproofing, it may disturb neighbors). The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem). The storage function makes it easy to store dishes hygienically at any time. The automatic door opening function only operates during the drying process, and it's a shame that it closes and doesn't stay open after the drying process is finished. The convenient water supply allows for convenient installation without having to place it on the kitchen floor. As a single-person household that drinks frequently, the dishwasher's configuration is simple: numerous cups, one or two rice bowls, two soup bowls, and two noodle bowls, two pots, two frying pans, and four sets of spoons. However, as a pattern of frequent dishwashing, purchasing a Minix dishwasher is a product that makes everyday life easier and more enjoyable. (Free from eczema!) The design is also appealing, and the 2-year after-sales service is also attractive. (Must register genuine product on the Minix official website!) Even though I'm a maximalist with a lot of interest in electronics, the dishwasher was especially difficult to bring in due to space constraints. Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and usability, my hands are a little softer now. If you're a household of 1-3 people considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate and get one. You won't regret it :)

Comments (English): [ If you have a household of 1-3 people and have eczema, look no further than the Minix dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || -Review written after purchasing it myself- Summary of key points Size suitable for use by 1-2 person households (operates by putting in 5 cups, 3 sets of spoons, 2 noodle bowls, 3 plates, etc. No inconvenience in the usage pattern of a single-person household) The basket provides practical storage, but when placing a large cup of 470-500 ml, the 2-tier tray slightly floats off the hanger (no problem in use) It is very easy to refill the water tank (even if you open the water tank with the provided large water cup and pour it conveniently, it fills quickly without overflowing) Based on the strong water flow and high-temperature water, the cleaning power is not inferior to that of a large dishwasher that I have used before. If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work. Stuck-on stains may not wash off completely (I found that the scrambled eggs in the silicone spatula wouldn't come off). The water supply and drain pumps aren't very noisy, but if you use it in a confined space like a studio apartment, avoid using it late at night (depending on the building's soundproofing, it may disturb neighbors). The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem). The storage function makes it easy to store dishes hygienically at any time. The automatic door opening function only operates during the drying process, and it's a shame that it closes and doesn't stay open after the drying process is finished. The convenient water supply allows for convenient installation without having to place it on the kitchen floor. As a single-person household that drinks frequently, the dishwasher's configuration is simple: numerous cups, one or two rice bowls, two soup bowls, and two noodle bowls, two pots, two frying pans, and four sets of spoons. However, as a pattern of frequent dishwashing, purchasing a Minix dishwasher is a product that makes everyday life easier and more enjoyable. (Free from eczema!) The design is also appealing, and the 2-year after-sales service is also attractive. (Must register genuine product on the Minix official website!) Even though I'm a maximalist with a lot of interest in electronics, the dishwasher was especially difficult to bring in due to space constraints. Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and usability, my hands are a little softer now. If you're a household of 1-3 people considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate and get one. You won't regret it :)

Comments (English): [ If you have a household of 1-3 people and have eczema, look no further than the Minix dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || -Review written after purchasing it myself- Summary of key points Size suitable for use by 1-2 person households (operates by putting in 5 cups, 3 sets of spoons, 2 noodle bowls, 3 plates, etc. No inconvenience in the usage pattern of a single-person household) The basket provides practical storage, but when placing a large cup of 470-500 ml, the 2-tier tray slightly floats off the hanger (no problem in use) It is very easy to refill the water tank (even if you open the water tank with the provided large water cup and pour it conveniently, it fills quickly without overflowing) Based on the strong water flow and high-temperature water, the cleaning power is not inferior to that of a large dishwasher that I have used before. If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work. Stuck-on stains may not wash off completely (I found that the scrambled eggs in the silicone spatula wouldn't come off). The water supply and drain pumps aren't very noisy, but if you use it in a confined space like a studio apartment, avoid using it late at night (depending on the building's soundproofing, it may disturb neighbors). The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem). The storage function makes it easy to store dishes hygienically at any time. The automatic door opening function only operates during the drying process, and it's a shame that it closes and doesn't stay open after the drying process is finished. The convenient water supply allows for convenient installation without having to place it on the kitchen floor. As a single-person household that drinks frequently, the dishwasher's configuration is simple: numerous cups, one or two rice bowls, two soup bowls, and two noodle bowls, two pots, two frying pans, and four sets of spoons. However, as a pattern of frequent dishwashing, purchasing a Minix dishwasher is a product that makes everyday life easier and more enjoyable. (Free from eczema!) The design is also appealing, and the 2-year after-sales service is also attractive. (Must register genuine product on the Minix official website!) Even though I'm a maximalist with a lot of interest in electronics, the dishwasher was especially difficult to bring in due to space constraints. Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and usability, my hands are a little softer now. If you're a household of 1-3 people considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate and get one. You won't regret it :)
