Sentence (English): Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and durability, my hands are a little softer now.
Comments (English): [ If you have a household of 1-3 people and have eczema, look no further than the Minix dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || -Review written after purchasing it myself- Summary of key points Size suitable for use by 1-2 person households (operates by putting in 5 cups, 3 sets of spoons, 2 noodle bowls, 3 plates, etc. No inconvenience in the usage pattern of a single-person household) The basket provides practical storage, but when placing a large cup of 470-500 ml, the 2-tier tray slightly floats off the hanger (no problem in use) It is very easy to refill the water tank (even if you open the water tank with the provided large water cup and pour it conveniently, it fills quickly without overflowing) Based on the strong water flow and high-temperature water, the cleaning power is not inferior to that of a large dishwasher that I have used before. If you use the reservation function + storage function, you can use clean dishes right away when you return from work. Stuck-on stains may not wash off completely (I found that the scrambled eggs in the silicone spatula wouldn't come off). The water supply and drain pumps aren't very noisy, but if you use it in a confined space like a studio apartment, avoid using it late at night (depending on the building's soundproofing, it may disturb neighbors). The noise level during washing isn't high, but the rotating noise of the upper blades is a bit annoying (not a major problem). The storage function makes it easy to store dishes hygienically at any time. The automatic door opening function only operates during the drying process, and it's a shame that it closes and doesn't stay open after the drying process is finished. The convenient water supply allows for convenient installation without having to place it on the kitchen floor. As a single-person household that drinks frequently, the dishwasher's configuration is simple: numerous cups, one or two rice bowls, two soup bowls, and two noodle bowls, two pots, two frying pans, and four sets of spoons. However, as a pattern of frequent dishwashing, purchasing a Minix dishwasher is a product that makes everyday life easier and more enjoyable. (Free from eczema!) The design is also appealing, and the 2-year after-sales service is also attractive. (Must register genuine product on the Minix official website!) Even though I'm a maximalist with a lot of interest in electronics, the dishwasher was especially difficult to bring in due to space constraints. Thanks to the Minix's convenient water supply and usability, my hands are a little softer now. If you're a household of 1-3 people considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate and get one. You won't regret it :)

Sentence (English): It is often past 9 PM by the time I finish the evening dishes, and my back and legs ache.
Comments (English): [ The evening becomes more relaxed. ] || ---------------- || It is often past 9 PM by the time I finish the evening dishes, and my back and legs ache. I take a long time to rinse, especially cups. If I rinse them just enough, they feel unhygienic, so I end up exhausting myself rinsing them thoroughly. After doing dishes for 10 years since getting married, I really wanted a dishwasher. I finally got one this time. I tend to look at the design first and then check the functions. I think the design is the best among all the dishwashers I've seen. It really suits my taste. It has a clean, minimalist style. The kitchen in my older 32-pyeong apartment is small, so I was able to place it there, fitting perfectly with hardly any extra space. The color is closer to gray than white. There is a barely visible stain on the bottom, but I decided to just use it as is because I couldn't be bothered to contact customer service. I do have a slight doubt that it might be a refurbished product, though. It wasn't exactly cheap, after all. They didn't give me an instruction manual. They told me to look at the website or YouTube. Curious if it really cleans well, I put lipstick on a cup and ran it; the cup was clean. However, there was still a lot of water left after the cycle finished, so... I tried the powerful drying cycle, but some moisture still remains. The operating sound isn't loud, but if you place dishes incorrectly, they make a noise as if they are bumping against each other inside. When I put a long silicone cooking utensil in the cutlery holder, the sound of it hitting the upper rotating blades was quite loud. Be careful! Also, the sound of the water draining is quite loud. Since it's my first time using it, arranging the dishes is a bit difficult. I'm writing this review leisurely after putting the dishwasher on. Sentence (English): I had a Bosch 800 series that I had purchased 5 years ago and it failed due to a power surge from a storm.
Comments (English): [ Improved version of the 800 series ] || ---------------- || I had a Bosch 800 series that I had purchased 5 years ago and it failed due to a power surge from a storm. So, I replaced it with this dishwasher. While they are the same model number, this one is actually quieter! They also made the following changes: 1. They added a silverware basket to the bottom rack even though there is still the top rack for silverware. So, you now have two options. I prefer the top rack. 2. They changed the water line connection to include a water sensor in the supply line. While this is nice, it increases the size of the opening if your water connection is in another cabinet. You will need a minimum of a 3 inch round hole to feed the new connector through. This also makes for a bulky connection at the water fitting. The new connector is a garden hose type so will NOT directly connect to your old connection. They include a short adapter hose for this and it works just fine. 3. The bottom rack is different and I am not sure it is an improvement. Maybe it will just take me time to adjust to the different configuration. It now has tines that fold down for large items. 4. The instructions are a bit vague in some places, but you can figure it out if you take your time. Top cabinet connections have been changed to corner brackets that push into the plastic on top in two slits on each side. They do not appear to fit because you need to press hard to get them to go in. 5. There is a new 30 minute wash cycle that does a very good job on lightly dirty dishes. 6. Be careful when ordering using a tablet. While the physical description on the website states that basic installation is included, it may not be in your area. When you put it into your basket to order, the statement that your area does not include installation does NOT show up unless you scroll to the end of the page! The delivery people will show up and drop off the dishwasher where you want it, but they will NOT remove packaging and will NOT take the old one. When asked, they tell you that an installer will contact you. That is NOT true if you are not in their installation area. You need to know that to tell them to take away the old unit because they believe that will be the installers job. They also believe that the installer will remove all packaging so they will not do it. The people are polite and try to do a good job, it is not their issue that they were not told what to do, that is a logistics issue that needs to be fixed. When I contacted customer service to ask about install, they told me in my area it was not included and then scheduled a time for the delivery team to come back and pick up the old unit, which they did. I am pleased with the product, but not a fan of the lack of installation or at least setup.

They added a silverware basket to the bottom rack even though there is still the top rack for silverware. So, you now have two options. I prefer the top rack. 2. They changed the water line connection to include a water sensor in the supply line. While this is nice, it increases the size of the opening if your water connection is in another cabinet. You will need a minimum of a 3 inch round hole to feed the new connector through. This also makes for a bulky connection at the water fitting. The new connector is a garden hose type so will NOT directly connect to your old connection. They include a short adapter hose for this and it works just fine. 3. The bottom rack is different and I am not sure it is an improvement. Maybe it will just take me time to adjust to the different configuration. It now has tines that fold down for large items. 4. The instructions are a bit vague in some places, but you can figure it out if you take your time. Top cabinet connections have been changed to corner brackets that push into the plastic on top in two slits on each side. They do not appear to fit because you need to press hard to get them to go in. 5. There is a new 30 minute wash cycle that does a very good job on lightly dirty dishes. 6. Be careful when ordering using a tablet. While the physical description on the website states that basic installation is included, it may not be in your area. When you put it into your basket to order, the statement that your area does not include installation does NOT show up unless you scroll to the end of the page! The delivery people will show up and drop off the dishwasher where you want it, but they will NOT remove packaging and will NOT take the old one. When asked, they tell you that an installer will contact you. That is NOT true if you are not in their installation area. You need to know that to tell them to take away the old unit because they believe that will be the installers job. They also believe that the installer will remove all packaging so they will not do it. The people are polite and try to do a good job, it is not their issue that they were not told what to do, that is a logistics issue that needs to be fixed. When I contacted customer service to ask about install, they told me in my area it was not included and then scheduled a time for the delivery team to come back and pick up the old unit, which they did. I am pleased with the product, but not a fan of the lack of installation or at least setup.

Sentence (English): We've been enjoying this dishwasher for about two months now.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Except for One Glaring Issue ] || ---------------- || We've been enjoying this dishwasher for about two months now. It is a great dishwasher overall. It cleans dishes, pots, pans, glassware exceptionally well. All three racks are very user friendly. It is well made and all of the parts and pieces feel like they're very good quality. The handle is solid and we like the small amount of texture on it that keeps wet hands from slipping off. The stainless steel face is almost finger-print proof. A huge bonus is that it is very, very quiet. We barely notice when it's running. However it has one issue that's apparently known to the company and has yet to be addressed. There is a small vent on the front, just above the handle that allows steam/heat to dissipate during the drying cycle. The vent collects a minor amount of water and when the door is opened it drips onto the floor. We didn't realize this was a problem with this model (and apparently some other Kitchenaid dishwashers), however it's well-documented online and on YouTube. Owners have had repairs completed under warranty to try and fix it, some more than once, without resolving the issue. Knowing that repairs can often cause more problems than they fix, we've elected to live with it. After emptying the dishes we use a paper towel to wipe up the few droplets of water on our wood floors. It's annoying, but given how well it works otherwise, we're going to live with it. Whirlpool/Kitchenaid may get this problem resolved one day, but there's "no known cure" to date. Otherwise, it has been an excellent dishwasher so far.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher a few weeks ago.
Comments (English): [ Entry-level dishwasher, nothing more ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher a few weeks ago. We use it at least twice a day. The appliance washes dishes very well, whether they are dirty or very dirty. On the other hand, the dishwasher is quite noisy when the hot water is pumped through the appliance, enough to interfere with a conversation in the room. That said, the biggest negative point is probably the drying. I use "Extra Dry" and "Night dry" and despite this, the dishes remain very wet (the plastic is not even slightly dried), despite using Jet Dry or others (I still hear the fan starting from time to time after washing). I am aware that this is an entry-level dishwasher, but why highlight its "Dynamic Dry Technology" and its low noise emission if these two issues are far from being strong points for this product?
Comments (Original): [ Lave-vaisselle d'entrée de gamme, sans plus ] || ---------------- || J'ai acheté ce lave-vaisselle il y a quelques semaines. Nous l'utilisons au moins deux fois par jour. L'appareil lave très bien la vaisselle, qu'elle soit sale ou très sale. Par contre, le lave-vaisselle est assez bruyant lorsque l'eau chaude est pompée dans l'appareil, assez pour nuire à une conversation dans la pièce. Ceci dit, le point le plus négatif est sans doute le séchage. J'utilise 'Extra Dry' et 'Night dry' et malgré cela, la vaisselle reste très mouillée (le plastique n'est même pas un peu séché), malgré l'utilisation de Jet Dry ou autres (j'entends pourtant le ventilateur partir de temps à autre après le lavage). Je suis conscient qu'il s'agit d'un lave-vaisselle d'entrée de gamme, mais pourquoi mettre de l'avant sa 'Technologie Dynamic Dry' et sa faible émission de bruit si ces deux enjeux sont loin d'être des points forts pour ce produit?

Sentence (English): They don't build them like they used to!
Comments (English): They don't build them like they used to! This Bosch was a 'replacement' for another Bosch I purchased 8 years ago. More expensive and yet lower quality. I am annoyed that this one requires WiFi and an App to get basic settings that the old one just had. The dishwasher takes longer to run a load and is somehow louder than the old one, even though this model is the 'quietest' category Bosch makes. The capacity inside is also smaller than the older model, even though the dimensions are the same. Overall, disappointed in all new appliances and the quality that is no longer present. The installation and delivery guys were great. Not sure why it took 5 of them to install this dishwasher, but maybe they were training 3 of them or something.

Sentence (English): So far we've had this dishwasher for about a month and we are very happy with how it is working.
Comments (English): So far we've had this dishwasher for about a month and we are very happy with how it is working. The dishes are getting clean and it's cool that you have the option to run just the top or just the bottom in case there is a small load. The fact that the top drawer is height adjustable is really slick so that if you have taller cups you can finally fit them without trying to angle them in weird ways. I love the specific jets that go up into cups, it helps clean out shaker cups that my sons use for protein shakes or mixing chocolate milk and that can be a pain to get cleaned out sometimes. The only reason that I'm not giving this a 5 is that opening and closing the door it feels a little cheap, not as solid and heavy as my old dishwasher. I'm hoping that never becomes an issue. It is a little bit of a pain that in my area this cannot be installed by the people that deliver the product. We got delivery on a Friday and they schedule a plumber to come out within 72 hours so I had a dishwasher in the middle of my kitchen for awhile but I understand that is no fault of Home Depot and has to do with local codes. But just be aware that it's likely that this will not be installed the same day of delivery if you get this. But the delivery drivers were great and so was the plumber that they sent.

The fact that the top drawer is height adjustable is really slick so that if you have taller cups you can finally fit them without trying to angle them in weird ways.  I love the specific jets that go up into cups, it helps clean out shaker cups that my sons use for protein shakes or mixing chocolate milk and that can be a pain to get cleaned out sometimes.  The only reason that I'm not giving this a 5 is that opening and closing the door it feels a little cheap, not as solid and heavy as my old dishwasher.  I'm hoping that never becomes an issue.  It is a little bit of a pain that in my area this cannot be installed by the people that deliver the product.  We got delivery on a Friday and they schedule a plumber to come out within 72 hours so I had a dishwasher in the middle of my kitchen for awhile but I understand that is no fault of Home Depot and has to do with local codes.  But just be aware that it's likely that this will not be installed the same day of delivery if you get this.  But the delivery drivers were great and so was the plumber that they sent.

Sentence (English): I honestly didn't trust dishwashers, so I debated for a very long time whether or not to buy one.
Comments (English): I honestly didn't trust dishwashers, so I debated for a very long time whether or not to buy one. But I am 200% satisfied—to the point where I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. It was a purchase I made with my own money and have no regrets. I was a bit surprised by how big it was; it was bigger than I expected. I wanted to place it sideways to make putting dishes in easier, but the width didn't allow for that, so I installed it facing forward. It looks better that way, but it is definitely a little inconvenient when loading dishes. I love that this dishwasher can be placed on a shelf, so I don't have to bend over when putting dishes in or organizing. Honestly, using a large dishwasher is a burden because of the high energy and water consumption. But I think the 6-place setting size is economical and beneficial if you run it just once a day. My quality of life has skyrocketed! The interior space is larger than I thought, so pots, pans, and everything else fit inside. It is also great that the tableware is designed to be stacked neatly. Also, before buying, I debated a lot about whether to get one with a hot air drying function. However, I chose the one without it because I heard that it consumes a lot of electricity... In conclusion, I think I made the right choice. Since it has an automatic door opening function, the residual heat helps the dishes dry quickly. However, if water pools in the concave areas (like the bottom of a cup or bowl), it doesn't dry out. But since I can just turn the bowl upside down in the morning to remove the pooled water, I didn't find it particularly inconvenient. I am truly 200% satisfied. Using a dishwasher makes life so much easier. Since the electricity and water bills aren't that high, I just run it around freely. It cleans things much better than I used to.

Sentence (English): I have been using BOSCH dishwashers for more than 10 years.
Comments (English): [ Negative Innovations ] || ---------------- || I have been using BOSCH dishwashers for more than 10 years. Previously I had the same 800 series model installed in 2014 and then the door came off so I upgraded to newer 800 model. But this model smaller in depth. The basket is smaller and the plate setting guides are all in single direction. In my old dishwasher one row had them left to right and other row had them back to front. This takes away a lot of flexibility. Bottomline, where earlier I was able to fit all my plates in one load and now only 70% of plates fit so I need to do two loads or run the dishwasher sooner.The installation is also not very clean. Post installation I a rubber flap hanging from bottom and two screws without any cover visible at the bottom panel.
